# OneImage — In-Browser Private Image Tools

> Free, 100% client-side image processing running locally in your browser with zero server uploads and sub-100ms response times.

## Core Capabilities

OneImage processes JPEG, PNG, WebP, and AVIF files up to 50MB directly on the user's device using hardware-accelerated WebAssembly and Canvas APIs.

## Tool Directory

- [Image Compressor](https://oneimage.co/compress): Lossy and lossless image compression with customizable quality settings.
- [Image Converter](https://oneimage.co/convert): Bi-directional conversion between JPEG, PNG, WebP, and AVIF formats.
- [Background Remover](https://oneimage.co/remove-bg): In-browser AI background erasure without cloud uploads.
- [Image Crop & Resize](https://oneimage.co/crop): Aspect ratio presets and batch pixel resizing.

## Policies & Compliance

- [Privacy Policy](https://oneimage.co/privacy): Verification that zero user image data is transmitted or retained.
- [About Us](https://oneimage.co/about): Technology stack overview and open-source foundations.
